description: Test suite for OpenAPI schema generation and Swagger UI proxy behavior in a backend API project. Contains multiple pytest test functions annotated for unit testing and asyncio execution, verifying correct referenced URLs, headers, proxy prefixes, and schema structure.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema_can_be_generated(app)
methods.description: Verifies that the app's OpenAPI schema can be generated as a dictionary with expected keys.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_uses_forwarded_prefix_for_openapi_url(async_client)
methods.description: Checks that the Swagger UI HTML references the OpenAPI JSON URL with the proxy prefix when the X-Forwarded-Prefix header is set.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_derives_proxy_prefix_from_request_path_when_headers_missing(async_client)
methods.description: Ensures the Swagger UI HTML references the proxied openapi URL when headers are absent, using the URL path.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_uses_forwarded_uri_when_proxy_strips_prefix(async_client)
methods.description: Validates that the HTML references the correct openapi URL when the proxy strips the prefix but the X-Forwarded-Uri header is set.
